title: ABEP pre-ionizer -> Hall interstage model, interchange format v1
description: Inputs ($defs/case) and outputs ($defs/result) of abep_sim/interstage.py (lane 18). One common model for rf_hall and ecr_hall; hall_only has no interstage and is not a valid case. Every numeric input is a sourced record (value, unit, source, evidence class, uncertainty) or an explicit {"tbd": "<what is required>"}; a TBD anywhere makes the solver refuse. There are no defaults: every property listed in 'required' must be present, and null is allowed only where the schema says so (mode-specific inputs). Equations, sources, validity domain and limitations: docs/architecture_comparison/interstage/INTERSTAGE_MODEL.md. This schema defines an interface; it is not a validation claim and ranks no architecture.

excluded_architectures.hall_only: no interstage: the Hall channel is fed directly; eta_transport is undefined and the interstage block is absent from the comparison

x-model.versioning: semantic: removing/renaming a field, changing a unit or a vocabulary = major; adding an optional output field = minor; description/source updates = patch

milestones.A: supports: the conditional statement 'rf_hall / ecr_hall is baseline provided eta_transport >= eta_transport_required (abep_sim/breakeven.py, breakeven_v1: place_evidence()['eta_transport_min'])' becomes computable and input-traceable
milestones.B: requires: admitted Hall transport closure (for eta_transport_required), sourced rates valid at the interstage T_e, magnetized wall-flux closure or measurement, junction capture data, transitional-flow conductance for the actual gas
milestones.C: requires: wall-heat and ion-wall-energy outputs coupled to abep_sim/thermal_life.py and the energy ledger coupled to bus_power_boundary_v1 (rf_source / ecr_source), with milestone-B inputs

unit.description: dimensionless: '-' or '1' (the breakeven_v1 spelling); both accepted

source.description: citation actually accessed (DOI/URL, table/equation), or the producing lane/script

uncertainty.description: stated uncertainty, or why none is stated

tbd.description: An input that is not available; the solver refuses (InterstageTBDError) until it is supplied.

species_map.description: species name -> sourced value; must list exactly the species the property applies to (ions or neutrals)

rate_record.description: k = k_ref_m3_s * (x / x_ref) ** exponent [m^3 s^-1] with x = variable; refused outside [validity_min, validity_max] (null = no bound stated by the source on that side; at least one bound required).

charge.description: 0 = neutral; Z >= 1 = ion (negative ions not implemented)

mass.description: kg; ion mass = neutral mass - Z m_e (mass closure)

source_exit.description: Pre-ionizer exit state (RF / ECR source lanes).

ion_axial_speed.description: m s^-1, every ion species (constant along the duct)

neutral_density.description: m^-3, every neutral species; gated against the flow-path value

neutral_flow.description: s^-1, every neutral species entering the duct

geometry.description: circular: radius set, inner/outer null; annular: inner/outer set, radius null.

wall_material.description: label only; wall coefficients are separate sourced inputs

electron_energy_loss.description: eV per event (sourced), or for electron-consuming recombination: (3/2) T_e (assumed; biased high for rate exponent alpha < 0) or (3/2 + alpha) T_e (model-derived, Maxwellian electrons, power-law rate); 'none' for heavy-particle reactions

process.description: declared process class; checked against the reaction structure; addresses the completeness key <process>:<each heavy reactant>

collision_cross_section.description: m^2 per neutral species (mean free path, Knudsen number)

explicit_conductance.description: m^3 s^-1 per neutral; explicit_conductance only

hall_path_effective_area.description: m^2 (area x transmission probability, exit -> space through the Hall channel)

energy_reference.description: reference state of the species formation energies

process_exclusions.description: required-process key -> justification (with source or bound); keys: volume_recombination:<ion>, electron_impact_ionization:<species>, ion_neutral_charge_transfer:<ion> (if neutrals exist), electron_impact_excitation:<species>, electron_elastic_energy_loss:<neutral>, electron_impact_dissociation:<molecular species>, wall_atom_recombination:<atomic neutral>

result.description: Output of solve_interstage. Only status OK carries performance numbers; INFEASIBLE / MODEL_ERROR results carry null performance fields and a status_reason plus diagnostics (never a half-converged state). Refusals (missing / TBD / out-of-domain inputs) raise instead of returning.

eta_transport.description: ion current delivered into the Hall channel / ion current leaving the source = eta_duct * eta_junction (can exceed 1 only if the case ionizes inside the duct)

eta_duct.description: ion current at the duct exit / ion current at the duct entry

eta_junction.description: captured / arriving ion current (null if no ion current arrives)

eta_transport_particle.description: ion particles delivered / ion particles entering

eta_transport_mass.description: ion mass flow delivered / ion mass flow entering

mass_delivery_fraction.description: (ion + neutral) mass flow into the Hall channel / total mass flow entering the duct

ions.description: per ion species: entry/exit/delivered/plume/wall-loss flows [s^-1], net volume-reaction change, speed, charge, Bohm speed and h at entry/exit

neutrals.description: per neutral species: entry/exit/to-Hall/leak flows [s^-1], entry/exit partial pressures and drop [Pa], duct and junction conductances [m^3 s^-1], supplied vs flow-path entry density and their mismatch

charge_state_fractions.description: entry / exit / delivered: element -> {charge Z: fraction of that element's ion particle flow}

neutral_transport.description: mode, duct regime and minimum Knudsen number, junction Knudsen number, transmission probability and its source, junction leak fraction, hydraulic diameter, fixed-point iterations

reactions.description: reaction id -> events [s^-1], rate coefficient used [m^3 s^-1], heat released per event [eV], process class, electron energy loss per event [eV] and its basis

wall.description: closure, sheath potential at entry/exit [V], ion wall impact energy [eV], wall heat [W] and mean heat flux [W m^-2], wall atom recombination events, magnetization diagnostics

energy_ledger_W.description: in / electron_heat_from_source_W / out / sinks / residual_rel [W]; under isothermal_source_conduction the residual is a bookkeeping consistency check (the conducted heat closes the electron energy balance by construction), not a physical conservation test

conservation.description: elements_rel, charge_rel, mass_rel, energy_rel, gate_rtol, passed

numerics.description: n_steps, step-doubling check and its tolerance

profiles.description: z_m, eta_duct(z), charge_state_fractions(z), neutral partial pressures(z)

provenance.description: every sourced input with source and evidence class

diagnostics.description: step-doubling change (null if not finite), step-doubling change of the entry partial pressure (bounds the quadrature error; boundary_rtol must not be set below it), flow-path vs supplied entry densities, boundary mismatch, conservation (present for non-OK results too; non-finite numbers are reported as null)
